why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with Supabase
why_use_section.subtitle: Supabase combines the reliability of PostgreSQL with the speed of modern Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platforms.
paragraphs: Supabase allows us to eliminate months of boilerplate backend engineering. By leveraging its auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, we can transition from schema design to frontend integration in hours rather than weeks, all while staying within the robust PostgreSQL ecosystem.

The platform’s greatest strength lies in its security model. By utilizing PostgreSQL's native Row Level Security (RLS), we ensure that data isolation and user permissions are enforced at the database level, creating a 'thick database, thin client' architecture that is inherently more secure.
